description: The 2023 Regular Session is now underway.The session began on Monday, January 9 when members of the 94th General Assembly took the oath of office.The House then elected Matthew J. Shepherd of El Dorado as the Speaker for the 94th General Assembly. He is the first person in state history to be elected Speaker for a third term.Speaker Shepherd announced the chairs and vice chairs for committees. You can find the committee rosters HERE.On the second day of the session, the House and Senate convened
